Subject: Dealer Training Facilities and Equipment Standards
CheckItem: Training facility/room shall be within standard room size based on Circular NTD-STS-2024-010
HowToCheck:
1. Standard training room 
Room size must be sufficient based on dealer category:
A – 37 & above m²
B - 30 to 36 m²
C – 25 to 29 m²
D – 18 to 24 m²
E – 16 to 18 m²
F – 15 to 16 m²

Subject: Dealer Training Facilities and Equipment Standards
CheckItem: Training facility/room shall have complete tools and equipment for training based on Circular NTD-STS-2024-010
HowToCheck:
1. Check tools and equipment:
• Table and chairs
• Projector/TV
• External speaker with 3.5mm jack 
• HDMI and/or VGA cable 
• Presentation clicker
• Office Supplies
• Whiteboard

Subject: Dealer Training Facilities and Equipment Standards
CheckItem: Sales Executives/Sales CROs must have a secured and stable internet connection during training
HowToCheck: 1. Check connection being used by SE.

Subject: Dealer Training Facilities and Equipment Standards
CheckItem: Dealers must have a dedicated computer/laptop within the required specification for training and other tools/software.
HowToCheck:
1. Check if the dealer follows the minimum requirement for desktop/laptop

• CPU: At least Ryzen 5/Intel Core i5 or 
higher 
• RAM: At least 8GB DDR4 or higher 
• Web camera: At least 720p or higher 
• Microphone: Internal microphone 
• SSD/HDD: At least 512GB internal 
storage or higher 
• OS: Licensed Windows 10 or higher 
• Productivity: Licensed Microsoft Office 
(Excel, PowerPoint & Word)

Subject: Showroom Area
CheckItem: Hero Car Display (new model) is displayed on a standard black platform.

Subject: Showroom Area
CheckItem: All installed A/C systems in the showroom and sales lounge are functioning properly

1. Check all A/C systems if they are properly functioning

-Showroom/Negotiation Area
-Showroom lounge

1. Check if the customer lounge and negotiation area have enough sofas/chairs that are comfortable, well-maintained, free from tears, and meet the MMPC VI Standard Requirements
2. Check if the dealer is not using monobloc chairs in the showroom area

1. Check if the amenity corner signage clearly states that it is intended for customers
2. Check if the amenity corner signage is clearly visible.

Subject: Showroom Area
CheckItem: Amenity corner has available snacks (biscuits, cupcakes, candies)

HowToCheck:
1. Check if the TV is working and accessible for viewing
2. Check if the Wi-Fi is available and  instruction on how to connect  to the Wi-Fi is available
3. Check if SE is doing proactive offering

Subject: Showroom Area
CheckItem: Rest Rooms must have clean water supply, toilet bowl, sink, urinal, bidet, trash cans, tissue, paper towel or hand dryer, and hand wash soap; no foul smell

1. Check all restrooms designated for customers (Male, Female, PWD)
2. Check if the restrooms are well-lit

Subject: Sales Operation

HowToCheck:
1. Check the actual SPC board.
- 1 General SPC Board for Branch Head
- 1 for each Sales Team
2. Check the ff:
- Complete and correct data
- Correct Pattern
- With progress indicator

HowToCheck:
1. Check Sales Activity Plan
2. Check if it follows a two-month rolling format
3. Check if the plan aligns with the actual activity

CheckItem: Conduct Gap analysis
HowToCheck:
1. Check the Gap analysis of the previous month
2. Check the Minutes of the Meeting (MOM) of the latest monthly Team Meeting to confirm if the Gap analysis was discussed

1. Check List of low performing SEs for both Sales and SSI
2. Check training schedule
3. Check the coaching forms compiled by the SM/TL or Sales Trainer.
4. Check the latest role play records

1. Check the availability of the area setting
2. Check market evaluation of the area
3. Check the assigned team in the area for saturation activity

Note: Check if the activity has been properly executed

For 1st half, check if dealer has plan to conduct Prospect Party.
For 2nd half, check if dealer conducted Prospect Party. Check proof such as photo and attendance list.

For 1st half, check if dealer has plan to have KOL.
For 2nd half, check if dealer conducted collaborated with KOL. Check proof such as photo and attendance list.

3. Ask the targets they recognize and follow
4. Check if their stated targets align with the actual SPC board

1. Interview to 2-3 SEs
2. Check if SEs can identify the sources of new leads and repeat customers.

1. Interview 2-3 SEs

1. Interview 2-3 SEs
2. Check if there are on-going loan application

1. Interview 2-3 SEs

- Thank you board with customer name
- Congratualtions Banner

Subject: Documentation
CheckItem:
All required documents are complete and duly signed by the customer, including:
1. Customer Information Sheet (CIS) and DPA Form  
2. Copy of Customer ID  
3. MMVSO (Vehicle Sales Order)  
4. SE Delivery Declaration Form (SDDF)
5. New Vehicle Releasing Checklist (NVRC)  
4. Sales Invoice (SI)  
5. Delivery Receipt (DR)
6. MMPC and Dealer’s copy of Warranty Certificate
HowToCheck:
1. Request the actual folder of release for the previous month from the Sales Admin/Accounting Staff; choose (3) samples.
2.Check if all required documents are complete and properly filled out with customer's signature

Subject: Documentation
CheckItem: All customer's  document has digital backup
HowToCheck:
1. Request the actual folder of release for the previous month from the Sales Admin/Accounting Staff; choose (3) samples.
2. Check if all key documents have been scanned and securely stored on a shared network or online drive and password-protected

Subject: Documentation

HowToCheck:
1. Check if all customer folders have proper labels and contain all necessary documents
2. Check if hard copies are securely stored in a locked filing cabinet.

Subject: Vehicle Delivery

HowToCheck:
1. Request the actual folder of release for the previous month from the Sales Admin/Accounting Staff; choose (3) samples.
2. Check NVRC attachment: "Arrival Time" and "Departure Time" should be within 2hrs for Cash / PO Transaction

1. Check the actual release area
2. Check if there are no vehicles parked in the release area aside from "for release" unit/s

HowToCheck: Check if the vehicle releasing area is located inside the showroom

1. Check if the Leads Database is available and includes customer data from the past 5 years
2. Check if the database is being utilized, monitored, and updated.

Sample:
Current year = 2025 → Extract customer database for 2019 and below

Subject: Monitoring

HowToCheck:
1. Check if there are fleet accounts
2. Check if fleet monitoring exists
3. Check if the fleet monitoring contact plan and tracking is updated

HowToCheck:
1. Check the Daily Release Monitoring
2. Check if the date in the PDI column is 3 days prior to delivery date

HowToCheck:
1. Check if all releases for the day are recorded on the Daily Release Monitoring
2. Check the current status of the vehicle vs. the monitoring sheet

Note: If no release for the day, check the scheduled release for the next 2 days.

1. Check photo or message of sending Birthday and Anniversary Greetings
2. Check if the monitoring is updated

HowToCheck:
1. Check if there are valid red alert items
2. Check if the valid Red Alert items are recorded in the complaint monitoring file
3. Check if the monitoring file is updated
4. Check if the monitoring file was submitted to MMPC on time by reviewing the submission date

1. Access the YANA and select New Vehicle > Delivery
2. Extract all data with a Delivery Date exactly three business days from the actual visit
